rows.text: Language for the interface and agent replies in this workspace.
Use 24-hour (15:05) or 12-hour (3:05 PM) time in chats, routines, and agent context.
Keep active reply steps expanded. You can still open or close them manually.
Show reasoning below the steps, including after completion. Available for Pi agents only.
Visible reasoning before the panel scrolls.
Reorder screens in the sidebar. Move them below its divider to hide them.
Show Asks only when an agent has a question for you.
Show Approvals only when an action needs your approval.
Play a sound when agents need you or finish. Notifications remain visible when muted.
Notifications arrive in a stack in the corner of the screen, over the other windows, and go away on their own. Off, the system’s own come back.
Choose the screen area for notifications. Default: bottom right.
Approve, refuse and answer right on the notification, without opening the conversation. A high-risk action asks you to hold the button.
Use light, dark, or system appearance with the operating system’s accent color.
Seconds before a notification goes. After that it fades, with a short pause to bring the pointer back.
Show one at a time: approvals, questions, then completions. Swipe to dismiss.
With the pointer on a notification it waits. The mouse wheel opens it whole, and closes it again.
One of each kind: done, mention, question, approval, and high risk.
Click the mic or press ⌥ Space (Mac) / Ctrl+Space to start; click again to stop. Transcription stays offline for review before sending.
Available in the installed app; disabled in development.
You’re on version 0.2.29. Automatic updates are off.
Shared with every agent: your role, priorities, and rules.
Export agents, skills, channels, and routines as Markdown, without credentials or chats. Import OpenBot or Grok Bot agents with connectors and search off.
Export agents, chats, memory, Wiki, and files as a ZIP for another Tucano. Connector passwords and AI logins stay on this computer.
Back up before deleting data. Automatic backups retain the last 7 daily copies.
Chat history and workspace records are stored in this database. Deleted data can leave unused space. 0.4 MB; no unused pages. Integrity check passed.
Reclaim unused space without deleting records. Available while agents are idle; the app waits until maintenance finishes.
What is kept of what was said and answered in this workspace. The period is checked once a day; the button below deletes at once.
Daily cleanup deletes older messages. 0 keeps all; agent overrides apply. Memory, Wiki, and usage records remain.
The default workspace cannot be deleted. You can still back it up or duplicate it.
With Enter: Shift queues; Alt steers; Shift+Alt restarts; Ctrl adds a line.
Allow 1–10 agent replies before waiting for you.
Resume work after a quit or crash, unless you stopped it. Paused agents wait until resumed.
Stop after no text or completed tools. Work that shows progress continues.
Default approval rules for all agents; override them on each agent’s page. Reading never needs approval.
After reading external content, sending, publishing, paying, deleting, and risky clicks need approval, even if a rule allows them.
Pause at the limit and ask you whether to continue.
For agents without a monthly limit, percentages use a base of 10 million tokens.
Routines require Tucano to keep running, even with its window closed.
Defer routines and triggers until quiet hours end. Direct messages still get replies.
Calling an outside agent with @handle creates a team-up channel with the current context. Team-ups close automatically.
Since last message. 0 keeps team-ups. Right-click to close.
Use detected harness folders or add a folder. Enabled folders appear in every agent’s skill list.
New harness folders are detected automatically, including Claude Code and Codex.
Change each agent’s model and thinking, or apply the same to several at once. Applies to future replies; replies already running continue as they are.
Leave the model blank to change only reasoning. Switching runtimes uses the default login; the fallback model stays unchanged.
Bulk changes include selected agents outside the search. Archived agents are included only when the option above is checked.
Run agents through your existing plans, gateway, or providers. Tucano does not access or store harness credentials.
Add Claude Code, Codex or Grok accounts, then assign them to agents. Sign in through the CLI; Tucano never stores your password.
Fast models for routing, suggestions, and browser controls. Assign a provider to each task below.
Choose a fast fallback model for channel replies when no classifier is assigned.
A classifier writes no text: it returns a choice, a yes/no or a score, with each option’s probability. The key stays in the system’s vault and never comes back to the screen.
Find controls by page text at no cost. If no match is found, agents use element numbers.
Match page text for free; use element numbers when no match is found.
Choose a provider in Classifiers › Browser controls.
Suggest answers and next steps using the providers assigned in Classifiers.
Off by default. Send questions and options to the classifier for suggestions. You choose; “Something else” is never suggested.
Send steps and reply context to the classifier to check suggested tasks. Others stay available; if none is chosen, all stay checked. Off by default.
Off: agents use their own models unless routing is enabled on their page.
Summarize older messages and extract lasting facts about you.
Runs about every 20 messages in long conversations.
Learns from your messages, not agent assumptions.
Save decisions, facts, and results to wiki pages. Disable per channel or DM in its menu.
New pages save immediately. Automatic also applies pending edits. Undo from History.
Find conflicts, outdated facts, and duplicates in Care.
Review full pages and sources to suggest a fix or ask you a question. Changes require your approval.
Use a repository as your wiki. Changes sync both ways.
Copy notes, folders, links, and attachments. The original vault stays unchanged.
Page types and writing rules for agents and the curator.
Use Tucano on your iPhone with everything here: your conversations, approvals and the questions agents ask you. It works on your home Wi-Fi, with this computer on.
Receive approvals, questions, and routine results in Telegram. Use buttons to approve, or reply to answer.
Telegram receives approval details, questions, and routine replies. The token stays in the system vault. High-risk actions need two taps.
Open a server workspace from the sidebar switcher; return with the bar above it. Its data stays on the server. Your local workspace is not uploaded.
The Tucano in this window: the agents, routines and apps of this computer.
Paste a trusted tucano://connect… or ?code= sign-in link. Anyone with it can control the server’s agents.
